name: CreateDevice

parameters.help_en: The name of the device
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the device
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the device belongs
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent device, such as the ID of the platform to which a camera belongs
parameters.help_zh: 上级设备ID，比如：摄像头所属的平台ID
parameters.name: parent_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the folder to which the device belongs
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the device. Valid values:
ipc: IP camera.
platform: Platform.
ied: Intelligent device
parameters.help_zh:
设备类型。取值范围：
ipc（摄像头）
platform（平台）
ied（智能设备）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically start the stream. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动启动流。取值范围：
true
false（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_start

parameters.help_en:
The national standard ID of the device.
This parameter is applicable only to the national standard protocol
parameters.help_zh:
设备国标ID。
仅适用于国标协议
parameters.name: gb_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the device
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The port of the device
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The URL of the stream on the device
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The username of the device
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The password of the device
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The vendor of the device
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the device
parameters.name: dsn

parameters.help_en: The longitude of the device
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.help_en: The latitude of the device
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable device location subscription. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用设备位置订阅。取值范围：
true
false（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_pos

parameters.help_en: The location subscription interval, in seconds
parameters.name: pos_interval

parameters.help_en: The AutoDirectory
parameters.name: auto_directory

parameters.help_en:
The subscribed national standard alarm methods. Valid values:
0: All.
5: Video alarm.
7: Other alarms.

An empty value indicates no subscription.
Multiple values are supported and must be separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
订阅的国标报警方式。取值范围：
0（全部）
5（视频报警）
7（其他报警）

空值表示不订阅。
支持多个，用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: alarm_method

parameters.help_en: The other parameters of the device, in the format of a JSON serialized string
parameters.help_zh: 设备其他参数，格式为JSON序列化的字符串
parameters.name: params
